title: Pickleball Injuries Cost $400 Million As Participation Boomed
hook: Pickleball looks harmless. Its injuries cost an estimated $400 million.
closing: A booming social sport still carries a real physical and financial cost.
question: Have you played pickleball yet?

segments.say: Pickleball reached 13.6 million American players, turning a niche pastime into a mainstream sport.
Pickleball already has 13.6 million players, more than halfway to tennis.
Pickleball injuries cost an estimated $400 million. The easygoing sport carries an expensive downside.
